description:
List official government documents without their Markdown bodies.

Use country (for example "us", "jp", or "eu") and source to narrow results. Federal
Register document types include "Rule", "Proposed Rule", and "Notice"; Japanese
RSS sources use their configured update class as document_type. EU sources cover
EUR-Lex legislation and case-law (document_number carries the CELEX number) and
European Commission press releases.
Call portal_get for a selected id when its full portal record is needed.
name: portal_list_government
